record.name: Smalltalk
record.reason: The pinned Linguist classifier groups Pharo exports, a file explicitly from GNU Smalltalk, teaching and tool-specific snippets, and generic methods. Its Squeak alias and shared extensions are classifier behavior. The exact sample set leaves the lead’s relation to any single language edition or governed identity unresolved.

review_limitations: The corpus establishes heterogeneity within the classifier, not language-system compatibility or one-to-one entity identity. Individual files with generic syntax remain unattributed to an edition.
scope: This decision concerns the exact Linguist Smalltalk record at its pinned line. The historically documented PARC language and Blue Book edition have separate direct authorities.
